stories.headline: Elon Musk says SpaceX will beat OpenAI in AI in six months
AI hits perfect Mensa IQ score of 151 off the charts
Claude solves nine-loop physics calculation breaking world record
Google launches satellite to test AI chips in orbit
Tesla registers 125 Cybercabs with biggest single day ever
SpaceX builds Americas largest battery pack to power AI cluster

caption:
Here's what happened in AI in the last 24 hours, from AI maxing out the IQ scale to SpaceX declaring war on OpenAI 👇

Elon Musk said SpaceX will beat OpenAI and Anthropic at AI within six months.

AI just hit 151 on the Mensa Norway IQ test, the highest score possible. Three years ago it scored 64.

Claude solved a 9-loop physics calculation. Most researchers stop at two or three loops. The previous record was 8.

Google is launching a satellite to test its AI chips in orbit, to see if they survive space. The project is called Suncatcher.

Tesla registered 56 Cybercabs in a single day, a new record, bringing its total fleet to 125.

SpaceX is building a 3.3 GWh battery pack in Tennessee to power its Colossus 2 AI cluster, enough to run the city of Memphis for two hours.

Three years ago it scored 64. Now it scores 151, and the computers that run it are heading to orbit. Every major company is building at the same time, faster than most people realize.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Tesla, Anthropic, Google, SpaceX, Elon Musk
